fee_notes: Standard $59,950 for single Studio franchise, non-refundable. Actual fees paid in fiscal 2025 ranged $0-$59,950 due to discretionary reductions, promotions, veteran discounts (25% off for qualified veterans), and existing franchisee discounts. Area Development Agreement pricing: 3 studios $150,000 new/$135,000 veteran, 5 studios $237,500 new/$213,750 veteran, each additional +$47,500 new/+$42,750 veteran.
